runs.t: Mesotherapy for Hair Fall
1. Hero & Intro
Mesotherapy for Hair Fall

Biotin gummies, multivitamins, an expensive serum or two. When hair starts falling, most of us reach for supplements first. The trouble is that only a small part of what you swallow actually makes it to your scalp, and creams struggle to get past the surface.

Mesotherapy for hair fall in Delhi takes a more direct route. A blend of vitamins, minerals, amino acids and growth factors, mixed specifically for your scalp, is delivered right into the layer where hair follicles sit. You can have it with very fine needles or with a needle-free option. Over a course of sessions, most people notice less shedding and hair that feels thicker and stronger.
Available at Dadu Medical Centre Vasant Vihar (South Delhi) & Rajouri Garden (West Delhi), under Dr. Nivedita Dadu.
2. How Mesotherapy Works

Your scalp has a middle layer, the mesoderm, where the hair follicles get their blood supply. Mesotherapy places nutrients straight into that layer. Because they skip the digestive system, more of what's delivered reaches the follicles than you'd get from tablets or a topical product. The treatment also helps improve blood circulation in the scalp, which keeps supporting your hair in between sessions.
3. What Goes Into the Blend
There's no one standard formula. After looking at your scalp, the doctor puts together a mix that suits the reason your hair is falling. It can include:
vitamins such as biotin and B-complex
minerals like zinc and selenium
amino acids, the building blocks of keratin, which your hair is made of
growth factors or peptides that help stimulate follicles and reverse shrinking
in some cases, medication that works against DHT, a hormone linked to pattern hair loss
4. Needle or Needle-Free
There are a few ways to deliver the blend.
Standard mesotherapy
uses very fine needles to place small amounts across the scalp.
Transdermal mesotherapy
is needle-free and uses electroporation, which opens up the skin's water channels so the nutrients can pass through.
MesoGrow
delivers the blend using microneedling or electroporation. Your doctor will suggest which suits you.
5. Benefits Section

The main advantage is that the nutrients go where they're needed rather than being diluted through your whole body. The blend is built around your scalp, so it targets the actual reason behind your hair fall. If needles make you nervous, there's a needle-free option. Downtime is next to nothing, and mesotherapy works well alongside HGP, low-level laser or microneedling when your hair needs extra support.
6. Ideal Candidates

Mesotherapy is used for male pattern baldness, female pattern thinning, diffuse thinning and a receding hairline. It also helps with hair fall triggered by stress (telogen effluvium) or by nutritional deficiencies. It's suitable for both men and women, and the doctor assesses each case before finalising the plan, sometimes with blood tests.
7. Process & Techniques
A session takes about 30 to 60 minutes.

It starts with a scalp assessment, sometimes along with blood tests, so the doctor can work out what's driving your hair fall. Your scalp is cleaned, and the blend is prepared for you. It's then delivered by fine needle injections or by electroporation, depending on the method chosen. A short scalp massage may follow, and you'll get aftercare instructions before you leave. With needles, most people feel only mild discomfort. The needle-free options are painless.
How many sessions?

Usually 6 to 10 for standard or transdermal mesotherapy, and 6 to 8 for MesoGrow. Sessions are spaced every two weeks or monthly, depending on how severe the hair fall is and how you respond. After the course, a maintenance session every one to three months helps hold the results.
What results look like:

Shedding usually drops and hair starts to feel thicker after four to six sessions. A receding hairline may begin to respond within three or four. The best and longest-lasting results come once you've finished the full course.
Recovery:
There's no real downtime. Your scalp may look slightly red or feel tender for a day or two.
Aftercare:
Don't wash your hair for at least 24 hours
Avoid heavy workouts and direct sun for a couple of days
Eat a balanced diet and drink enough fluids
Restart any prescribed hair serums two to three days after the session

10. FAQs
Q: What is hair mesotherapy?
Ans. A treatment where a custom blend of vitamins, minerals, amino acids and growth factors is delivered into the scalp to support healthier hair growth.
Q: Is it painful?
Ans. With needles, there's mild discomfort. If you'd rather avoid needles, transdermal mesotherapy is painless.
Q: How many sessions will I need?
Ans. Usually 6 to 10, spaced every two weeks or monthly, followed by maintenance every one to three months.
Q: Does it work for both men and women?
Ans. Yes. The blend is adjusted to the cause of hair fall, whether that's pattern hair loss, stress or a deficiency.
Q: What is transdermal mesotherapy?
Ans. A needle-free method that uses electroporation to push nutrients through the skin's natural water channels.
Q: When will I see results?
Ans. Most people notice less shedding and thicker-feeling hair after four to six sessions.
Q: Is there any downtime?
Ans. Not really. Some redness or tenderness may last a day or two.
Q: What does it cost in Delhi?
Ans. Roughly ₹4,000 to ₹10,000 per session, depending on the method. The exact cost is confirmed at your consultation.
